what_to_detect: An attacker with trample over planeswalkers attacking a planeswalker assigns excess damage beyond the planeswalker's loyalty to its controller.
near_miss: An attacker with plain trample, or none, attacking a planeswalker, which cannot assign damage to the controller.
record_fields: combat payload damage_dealt events to player and planeswalker

what_to_detect: An attacker with trample over planeswalkers whose attacked planeswalker has left combat assigns all its damage to the defending player.
near_miss: An attacker with plain trample, which deals no damage to the player once the planeswalker is gone.
record_fields: combat payload damage_dealt events to player and planeswalker

what_to_detect: An attacker without trample over planeswalkers whose attacked planeswalker is gone deals no combat damage to the defending player.
near_miss: An attacker with trample over planeswalkers in the same position, which deals all its damage to the defending player.
record_fields: combat payload damage_dealt events to player and planeswalker
